caption: The drawing is comprised of several architectural and ornamental elements arranged within a single outlined rectangular frame. In the upper left, there is a finial with a bulbous base and a rounded top. Below it is a vertical baluster with a square top and a wider, sculpted central section, tapering toward the base. To the right of these are two symmetrical vertical pendants featuring scrollwork and a teardrop-shaped lower part, each suspended by thin lines. At the top right, there are three linear moldings, each with a different profile, and below them a small knob and a circular shape suggestive of a rosette. Further down and more central are two large molding profiles, each with multiple stepped curves. In the bottom left corner, there is an ornate corner decoration composed of a stylized, partially shaded floral motif surrounded by scrollwork and dot patterns. The dominant color is black ink on a light or off-white background, with all objects precisely outlined and lacking filled colors except for some hatching in the floral motif. The visual style is technical and schematic, emphasizing the structural form of each object.
title: Grandfather Clock
